d: The Warriors defeated the Celtics, 88-87 tonight in Golden State. Brandin Podziemski contributed a team-high 18 points to go with 7 rebounds 4 three pointers and 2 assists, with Charles Bassey of the Warriors adding an additional 13 points (6-7 FG) in the game. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 27 points along with 10 rebounds for the Celtics in the losing effort. The Warriors improve their record to 9-8 with the win, while the Celtics fall to 11-6 for the season.
